content:
DEV-12 is In Review and complete. The deliverable is Dev C's 07:57 sign-off comment, which has `final.patch` attached along with the test output. Nothing has changed since then.

This was my last automatic check-in: my wakeup used its 20th fire on this run and has paused itself. Dev A's and Dev D's have also paused, so only Dev C's might still fire a few more times. I posted a final one-line comment saying that.

I won't run again on this issue unless someone mentions me or a new trigger is set, for example if changes to the patch are requested before you merge.
